approach_a_measured.measurement_basis: Persisted DM02 campaign record, not an estimate.
approach_a_measured.name: CURRENT_CAMPAIGN_ONE_NEW_IMAGE_PER_PANEL
principal_risks: Two text-only back-matter pages are incorrectly counted as image-generation operations.
Every panel receives the same 18% safe-region geometry regardless of actual lettering load.
No approved DM02 character or environment pixels exist for continuity roles C or D.
The uniform two-attempt ceiling exposes the campaign to 88 operations despite DM04's low first-pass acceptance rate.

approach_b_proposed.name: BALANCED_24_PAGE_SHARED_MASTER_EDITION
reframe_conditions: The future master must visibly contain the target panel's exact character identities, action state and focal detail at usable crop resolution.
Each crop remains a separately reviewed panel asset and inherits no approval from the master.
If a crop cannot protect its lettering region or loses facial/hand clarity, promote that target back to a unique generation rather than fabricating detail.
risks: Close crops may lack facial or hand resolution.
The 71-word hymn and other dense pages still need page-specific lettering geometry.
Thirty-five first-pass masters remain too large for one ungated batch without approved DM02 identity/location references.

additional_combines.result: One transition composition with Medhas's hand/fire in the foreground and the three listeners receding into the opening cosmic field.
additional_combines.risk: Loses the deliberate close-to-wide rhythm and may crowd the 16-word caption if the transition is over-detailed.

additional_combines.result: One split-focus composition with Brahmā's direct appeal above and the six subtle pre-withdrawal loci on Viṣṇu below.
additional_combines.risk: May prematurely literalize withdrawal or make the 76-word page too dense; page 11 must remain the first actual withdrawal.

additional_combines.result: One high oblique composition introducing the separate dry-earth plane and proving water surrounds it without a body platform.
additional_combines.risk: Combining entrance and proof weakens the reveal and increases the chance of an accidental bodily-locus reading.

approach_c_lean_complete.name: LEAN_COMPLETE_24_PAGE_EDITION
principal_risks: More source transitions must coexist in single images, increasing provider omission and ordering risk.
Page 10 and page 20 become less forgiving of safe-region failure.
The reduction is specification-level only and requires a new validated storyboard/campaign before execution.

removals.risk: The final three-level geography echo is lost.
Brahmā and Yoganidrā cease to be visible distant witnesses on the combat-opening page.

classification_contract.rule: Every storyboard panel has exactly one primary classification from this exact list; analysis_category retains the review's internal production reasoning.

dm04_failure_evidence_summary.dm02_consequence: Every future master must be composed around a visibly low-detail safe band and reviewed at actual pixels before lettering.
dm04_failure_evidence_summary.evidence: All eight PR6 proof attempts and multiple PR11/PR12 panels occupied locked top lettering regions despite explicit instructions.

dm04_failure_evidence_summary.dm02_consequence: Distinct source actions and viewpoint changes remain unique; only same-instant reframes are candidates for a shared master.
dm04_failure_evidence_summary.evidence: PR11 page 1 produced strong single-scene art but failed the locked two-panel wide-to-close unit.

dm04_failure_evidence_summary.dm02_consequence: A reframe is permitted only when the future master already contains the exact character, action and continuity detail required by the target panel.
dm04_failure_evidence_summary.evidence: PR13 found that crops could reuse exact page-1 action but could not create missing donor maps, arrow exchanges, breath, equipment loss or decisive actions.

dm04_failure_evidence_summary.dm02_consequence: Pages 4, 6, 9, 11, 14-16 and 20-21 require strict negative prompts, exact bibles and independent review; page 11 and page 21 require proof gating.
dm04_failure_evidence_summary.evidence: DM04 outputs repeatedly introduced halo disks, force fields, extra weapons, palaces, mounts or omitted required source actions and identities.

dm04_failure_evidence_summary.dm02_consequence: Do not scale a full campaign from prose bibles alone; approve representative DM02 identity and environment references first.
dm04_failure_evidence_summary.evidence: PR12 recorded five of five generated images as FIX and linked continuity failures to unavailable approved character and setting pixels.

dm04_failure_evidence_summary.dm02_consequence: Lettering and crop success may validate composition mechanics only; it never inherits semantic approval to the source images.
dm04_failure_evidence_summary.evidence: PR12/PR13 achieved a private composed-page PASS while preserving both underlying image statuses as FIX.

full_page_reviews.failure_prevention: Reserve the full top safe band as low-detail water/sky and forbid all ordinary landmarks.
full_page_reviews.reason: The shoreless ocean is the scale-setting page-turn and can be rendered without character-continuity risk.
full_page_reviews.title: Water Without Shore

full_page_reviews.failure_prevention: Show only scene-required anatomy, no fixed four-arm or hood count, no halo or extra equipment, and preserve the top lettering band.
full_page_reviews.reason: This is the first sacred identity lock for Viṣṇu, Śeṣa and the non-anatomical sleep field; compression would weaken the cosmic stillness.
full_page_reviews.title: Sleep Beyond the World

full_page_reviews.failure_prevention: Do not render anatomical gore at the ear-region, weapons, armies or an invented motive; keep both Asuras distinct and fully in frame.
full_page_reviews.reason: The origin, threat direction, lotus geography and six-figure continuity must be read in one spatial event.
full_page_reviews.title: The Threat at the Lotus

full_page_reviews.failure_prevention: Design a low-detail lettering field before generation and keep Brahmā's praise attributed; do not literalize hymn epithets or add a weapon array.
full_page_reviews.reason: The attributed hymn needs devotional scale, but its 71 words cannot be assumed to fit a generic 18% safe strip.
full_page_reviews.title: Brahma's Hymn

full_page_reviews.failure_prevention: Use six unmistakable but modest radiance paths, no seventh locus, no permanent-residence implication, no halo/weapon array and no crowded architecture.
full_page_reviews.reason: All six source-named withdrawal groups and the separate appeared presence are irreducible; this is analogous to DM04's failed donor/body mapping scenes.
full_page_reviews.title: When Sleep Stood Apart

full_page_reviews.failure_prevention: Use wave rings and light bands rather than duplicated figures, clocks, armies, weapons or injuries.
full_page_reviews.reason: One nonliteral duration tableau efficiently carries five thousand years without generating repeated combat bodies.
full_page_reviews.title: Five Thousand Years

full_page_reviews.failure_prevention: Keep dry earth visibly separate from every body, omit anatomical impact and gore, use only the discus, and protect the full lettering band.
full_page_reviews.reason: The sourced discus, unflooded-earth condition and unresolved bodily locus make this the highest-risk decisive image.
full_page_reviews.title: Where the Earth Was Not Flooded

recommended_edition.approval_statement: No image, crop, character design, location design, page or edition is approved by this review; all reuse is proposed future planning only.
recommended_edition.name: BALANCED_24_PAGE_SHARED_MASTER_EDITION
required_preconditions: Revise and deterministically validate the storyboard and campaign; this review does not modify authoritative artifacts.
Treat pages 23 and 24 as deterministic layout, not image generation.
Approve exact DM02 character and environment reference pixels before scaling beyond proofs.
Run the four proof-first units and independent actual-pixel review before authorizing the remaining masters.
Use page-specific lettering geometry; do not rely on the generic top 18% instruction alone.
Preserve all source boundaries, especially the six Yoganidrā withdrawal groups and the unresolved defeat body locus.
recommended_edition.why: It removes nine operations without deleting any scripted panel or merging distinct source actions. The additional five-operation saving in C depends on compression patterns that DM04 evidence identifies as failure-prone.
